Messages.Author: Marc René Delhalle
Messages.Body:
Hello world!

Last week we got two questions in our play group:

Some Toreador are using the "Toreador Grand Ball". Do we understand the
card correct by saying "Every action except bleeding is unblockable" ?
Or should it be read as "Each action is unblockable until this minion
made a bleed action" ??

Could you give us a detailled description for the use of the "Tomb of
Rameses III"?
(E.g. putting this card on vampire A, but transfering blood to another
vampire B; using other Cards to transfer/move blood on a vampire etc.
pp)
There is sometimes a little bit confusion...

thanx
Marc

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Marc René Delhalle wrote:
> Last week we got two questions in our play group:
>
> Some Toreador are using the "Toreador Grand Ball". Do we understand the
> card correct by saying "Every action except bleeding is unblockable" ?
> Or should it be read as "Each action is unblockable until this minion
> made a bleed action" ??

You are correct in reading the former.

> Could you give us a detailled description for the use of the "Tomb of
> Rameses III"?
> (E.g. putting this card on vampire A, but transfering blood to another
> vampire B; using other Cards to transfer/move blood on a vampire etc.
> pp)
> There is sometimes a little bit confusion...

For every blood that you transfer (i.e., spend a transfer to move a
blood from your pool) to *any* uncontrolled vampire, the ToRIII adds
a blood to the chosen vampire (the uncontrolled vampire that the Tomb
is "on").

Tomb pays no attention to blood added by Govern the Unaligned or by
Arcane Library, Eco Terrorists, etc.

Tomb will add blood to a vampire under the effects of a Brainwash
(even though you can't use transfers to that vampire to either move
blood to or from the vampire).
